# Phase One — Chesed: Every Plausible Long-Render Architecture

The Awtsmoos is beyond queue and codec, yet Awtsmoos.com lets each frame enter a finite vessel without blocking the river's flow.

## Candidate causes of the frame-12 stall
- MediaBunny internal encoder queue reaches its own high-water mark and `add()` awaits a dequeue event that is never wired.
- Our shared wrapper queues frames but never starts/continues `_processFrameQueue` after the first drain cycle.
- The worker closes ImageBitmaps too late and backpressure is actually GPU resource exhaustion.
- MediaBunny `VideoSampleSource.add()` requires sequential timestamps but a floating-point boundary near frame 12 exposes validation.
- Worker request acknowledgement is emitted before encoding finishes, hiding a later encoder failure until queue saturation.
- OffscreenCanvas or VideoFrame lifetime prevents more than a small number of outstanding samples.
- `maxCacheFrames` is 8 but another queue threshold around 12 produces a deadlock between wrapper queue and codec queue.
- The full soundtrack buffer memory plus encoded video queue leaves insufficient memory for continued frame production.
- The browser target remains alive but the worker has thrown an exception that is not routed as `FATAL_ERROR`.

## Candidate repairs
A. Add explicit MediaBunny queue drain promise and wait only when encoder queue crosses a threshold.
B. Encode synchronously one frame at a time and acknowledge only after MediaBunny has accepted/drained it.
C. Use bounded batches: 4–8 frames, await drain, continue.
D. Add `flushVideo()` checkpoints every scene or N frames.
E. Chunk the movie into independent scene-group MP4 fragments, then concatenate/remux.
F. Separate audio and video rendering completely, mux only after both artifacts exist.
G. Fall back to ffmpeg-based image-sequence encoding for long canonical proof while preserving WebCodecs for browser preview.
H. Build a resumable render-job layer above both WebCodecs and ffmpeg.

## Chosen direction criteria
First repair the existing WebCodecs path with evidence and bounded backpressure because the 3-second proof already validates its codec/mux result. Then, after full 180-second proof, add chunk/resume as architecture rather than hiding the immediate defect behind a different encoder.
